basis: Lysosomal disease with defining skeletal and developmental impairment; valve dysfunction 80-99%. Skin/gingiva (80-99%) and airway/hearing disease (30-79%) omitted at cap.

decisions.neurologic: primary: developmental impairment is explicitly defining; global developmental delay occurs in 7/9 and cognitive impairment in 30-79%.

basis: Sterol synthesis disorder with defining intellectual disability and brain malformations; arthrogryposis 5/6, cleft palate 80-99%. Ocular findings (6/9) omitted at cap.

decisions.neurologic: primary: intellectual disability is defining; developmental delay 9/9 and corpus callosum agenesis 10/10 confirm central nervous system disease.

basis: Developmental disorder with defining joint and eye abnormalities; tracheomalacia 1/1 and sleep apnea 3/3 support airway involvement. Hearing loss (1/1 assessed per type) omitted at cap; small samples.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: structural airway disease (tracheomalacia 1/1 assessed), with sleep apnea in 3/3; respiratory involvement retained at cap.
decisions.otologic: none: hearing loss is reported in 1/1 assessed per type, but omitted at cap in favor of respiratory disease supported by apnea in 3/3.

basis: Copper disorder with neurodegeneration and marked skeletal/connective tissue defects; vascular dilatation 80-99%, arterial stenosis 30-79%. Hair/skin abnormalities (80-99%) omitted at cap.

decisions.cardiovascular: involved: vascular dilatation occurs in 80-99% and arterial stenosis in 30-79%; intrinsic vascular disease can cause severe injury.
decisions.dermatologic: none: characteristic hair/skin changes occur in 80-99%, but omitted at cap to retain more consequential skeletal and vascular damage.
decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: marked connective tissue anomalies define Menkes disease; joint hypermobility and chest/abdominal muscle defects occur in 80-99%.

basis: Defining developmental impairment, skeletal maturation abnormalities and muscle fiber disproportion. Constipation (80-99%) alone does not establish intrinsic bowel damage.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: constipation occurs in 80-99%, but no direct intestinal injury or established primary motility disorder is documented.

basis: Scalp aplasia and limb/skull defects define AOS; cardiac malformations and hydrocephalus each annotated 30-79%. Ocular defects (30-79%) omitted at cap, prioritizing severe cardiac and brain disease.

decisions.neurologic: involved: hydrocephalus is annotated 30-79%; retained for potentially severe brain injury despite less frequent intellectual disability and seizures.
decisions.ocular: none: cataract and microphthalmia are annotated 30-79%, but omitted at the four-axis cap in favor of cardiac malformations and hydrocephalus.

basis: Motor neuron disease with defining diaphragm paralysis, denervation weakness and joint contractures in most patients. Respiratory failure arises from skeletal muscle paralysis.

decisions.pulmonary: none: respiratory failure is caused by denervation and diaphragm paralysis; no intrinsic lung or airway disease is established.

basis: Neurodegeneration with fixed pes cavus and neurogenic bladder, each 30-79%, causing skeletal deformity and urinary dysfunction. Eye movement signs reflect neurologic disease.

decisions.ocular: none: strabismus (80-99%), nystagmus and supranuclear gaze palsy reflect motor control dysfunction; intrinsic eye damage or visual loss is not established.
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: pes cavus occurs in 30-79% and represents persistent structural foot deformity, beyond neurologic spasticity alone.

basis: Acute postinfectious brain dysfunction; an infectious trigger alone does not establish direct CNS infection or an immune-mediated disease across this umbrella.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: postinfectious triggering is established, but direct infection or a shared immune-mediated pathogenesis is not established across this umbrella.

basis: IL6R immunodeficiency with chronic eczematous dermatitis in most reported patients (>50%); recurrent infections alone do not establish lasting damage to other organs.

decisions.dermatologic: involved: persistent eczematous dermatitis affects most reported IL6R-deficient patients (>50%); intrinsic immune dysregulation, not a transient rash.
